A Little Something for Kiyana

A completely separate note from John’s 30th birthday.

Kiyana’s birthday is coming up in February, and we’re planning some KPop Demon Hunters entertainment to make her birthday extra special! 🎤✨

If you’d like to contribute towards her entertainment, you’re very welcome to — but there’s absolutely no pressure or expectation to contribute. 💜

Optional contribution
If you’d like to contribute, you can send it directly to Kiyana below.
A quick note: Kiyana has her own bank account, but the account is held in my name, which is why my name appears when you follow the payment link. Your contribution will go directly into Kiyana’s account. 💜
When making a contribution, please use the reference KPOP - [YOUR NAME] so we know who to thank.
